module.name: EKS Cluster CNEInstall
module.description: Apply the CNEInstance CR on AWS EKS, lay down the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap and (optionally) the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) for VIP allocation, and wire AWS IRSA for the CNE controller (IAM role + OIDC trust + SA annotation + rollout-restart).

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Forge resolves to access_key_id at deploy time.

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Forge resolves to secret_access_key at deploy time.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

required.reason: Provides eks_cluster_name and cluster_oidc_issuer_url for IRSA trust binding
FLO must be running and BNK CRDs registered before applying CNEInstance

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved from credential template (any auth method).

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Resolved from credential template.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region (used for the AWS provider client).

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: EKS cluster name. Used for IAM resource naming.

required.name: vpc_id
required.description: EKS cluster VPC ID. cneinstall rediscovers f5-bnk-role=tmm-external subnets at apply time scoped to this VPC, so any HP-nodes TMM subnets created earlier in the same blueprint land in the BNKGateway CR.

required.name: cluster_oidc_issuer_url
required.description: OIDC issuer URL of the EKS cluster.

required.name: manifest_version
required.description: BNK manifest version (referenced in the CNEInstance CR).

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token (STS / SSO / assumed-role). Empty for static keys.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where CNEInstance CR is created (also where FLO + CNE controller live).

optional.name: far_secret_name
optional.description: FAR image pull secret name.

optional.name: cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: ClusterIssuer name referenced by CNEInstance.spec.certificate.

optional.name: flo_ready
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO module — must be true before applying CNEInstance.

optional.name: crds_installed
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO — BNK CRDs must be registered before applying CNEInstance.

optional.name: instance_name
optional.description: Name of the CNEInstance CR.

optional.name: deployment_size
optional.description: CNEInstance deploymentSize per F5 docs. One of: Small (2 CPU, 4 GiB hugepages-2Mi), Medium (4 CPU, 8 GiB), Large (8 CPU, 16 GiB), Max (16 CPU, 25 GiB).

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.description: Number of TMM replicas. 0 = auto-derive from cluster topology: min(availability_zone_count, worker_node_count). Set a positive number to override.

optional.name: availability_zone_count
optional.description: Number of AZs the cluster spans. Auto-wired from cluster-register; used as the natural ceiling for the smart tmm_replicas default.

optional.name: worker_node_count
optional.description: Total worker node count. Auto-wired from cluster-register; caps the smart tmm_replicas default (TMM pod can't schedule without a node).

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.description: Which namespaces the CNE controller watches for Gateway/HTTPRoute CRs. ["All"] = everything.

optional.name: network_attachments
optional.description: NAD names attached to TMM. Defaults to the ipvlan NAD that the future network-setup module will provide.

optional.name: storage_class_name
optional.description: StorageClass for CNEInstance persistent state.

optional.name: cloud_az_subnet_mappings
optional.description: AWS AZ → subnet mapping for the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap. Auto-wired from eks-cluster-register.cloud_az_subnet_mappings — discovered from the EKS cluster's own VPC config, so users don't have to re-enter what EKS already knows.

optional.name: vip_cidr
optional.description: Explicit CIDR for BNK Gateway VIP allocation. Resolution: (1) if set, builds a single listener-network from this CIDR (overrides discovery); (2) else if cluster-register tag-discovered tmm_external_subnets_by_az is non-empty, auto-builds multi-AZ listener networks; (3) else skips the BNKGateway CR.

optional.name: tmm_external_subnets_by_az
optional.description: TMM external subnets per AZ, discovered by cluster-register via the AWS subnet tag 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external'. Auto-wired; user shouldn't set this directly. Customers tag their TMM data-plane subnets in AWS, then the cneinstall module auto-builds the BNKGateway CR from those.

optional.name: bnk_gateway_name
optional.description: Name of the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway).

optional.name: vip_network_name
optional.description: Logical name for the VIP listener network in the BNKGateway CR.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where the CNEInstance CR lives.

key_outputs.name: cne_controller_role_arn
key_outputs.description: IAM role ARN assumed by the CNE controller via IRSA.

key_outputs.name: cloud_network_mapping_applied
key_outputs.description: True if the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap was applied.

key_outputs.name: bnk_gateway_applied
key_outputs.description: True if the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) was applied (i.e. vip_cidr was non-empty).

key_outputs.name: effective_tmm_replicas
key_outputs.description: The tmm_replicas value actually applied. Equals user override if set, otherwise min(AZ count, worker node count).

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once IRSA wiring (annotate + rollout-restart) is complete.
